description.value: Oak & Thorne is a sports-bar-style neighbourhood public house in Langley operated by the Joseph Richard Group, combining arcade games (ping-pong, foosball, Skee-Ball), a never-ending tap list, and large viewing screens for a game-day atmosphere. The menu spans pub classics to shared plates with a strong selection of dietary options, and the venue shifts into a nightlife destination on weekends. Outdoor seating is available, making it a viable refuelling stop for cyclists riding through the Fraser Valley.
